name: kxusairanagreement
title: US-Iran nuclear deal?
settlement: If the United States has agreed to, signed, or accepted a new Iran-US nuclear deal before the deadline, the market resolves Yes. A qualifying deal is a formal written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both governments that imposes verifiable restrictions on Iran's nuclear program (enrichment, centrifuges, facility operations) and lifts/suspends/modifies at least one US sanction in exchange.
decideContext: Estimate the probability that a verifiable US-Iran nuclear agreement (as defined) is reached before the market's deadline; resolution requires both a nuclear-restriction component with verification and a reciprocal sanctions-relief component, publicly agreed or signed by authorized representatives of both governments.
